evals.name: Objective Assertion Evaluation & Visual Scorecard
evals.prompt: Evaluate frameworks/angular/skills/angular-enterprise-forms against its test suite in evals/evals.json and output a visual scorecard.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-aware evaluation report: explicit deterministic file existence checks, semantic NOT_EVALUATED statuses without an agent run, and no invented baseline uplift.
assertions: Discovers target skill directory and validates SKILL.md and evals/evals.json
Verifies a file-presence assertion only when its text exactly equals files_exist and a files array is given
Reports semantic assertions as NOT_EVALUATED without actual agent-run evidence
Emits a deterministic coverage score and benchmark: null unless separate empirical results exist

evals.name: Failure Diagnostics & Remediation Prescription
evals.prompt: Run evaluations where a semantic assertion has no grader and a declared files_exist check is missing its expected file.
evals.expected_output: Marks the absent explicit files_exist assertion as failed, leaves semantic claims NOT_EVALUATED, and never fabricates benchmark results.
assertions: Explicit files_exist check fails when expected files are absent
Natural-language assertions mentioning 'file' or 'scaffold' do not auto-pass
Output schema uses verdict verified/failed/not_evaluated and benchmark null
Returns a nonzero status for failed or unverified actual evaluations
